title: Monsters Moshing
html:
Quest Giver: Tipper Gourd

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 100 Poison Grunt Moshers and 50 Poison Mystic Moshers. These are located in the lower areas of The Mutanous Malaise dungeon and the upper area branches. Return to Tipper Gourd in The Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine on completion.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Tipper Gourd

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Monster Mash

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill 100 Poison Grunt Moshers and 50 Poison Mystic Moshers. These are located in the lower areas of The Mutanous Malaise dungeon and the upper area branches. Return to Tipper Gourd in The Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine on completion.

Offer:

This will never do. We have to protect the children from these kinds of immoral shenanigans. Apparently this 'Moshing' has spread to other dungeons like a rash on the backside of a ruffian whose wearing tight leather knickers on a hot, hot summer's day. I have half a mind...to go down...there and give them a piece...of my mind. Oh, this headache and all this tension have got my shoulders tense. You have strong hands--rub my neck as I tell you what I need for you to do next for the Citizen Action Committee. I need you to waltz down to that dungeon and terminate those Moshing Hooligans before their sickness migrates further up towards town and infects all those fine strapping men of Townston with their tomfoolery. Well...hurry up. Get rid of those three stooges and get back to The Mutanous Mallaise Mezzanine, pronto. I, Tipper Gourd, have causes to champion.

Turn-in:

It is always a pleasure to know that someone like you is always there to protect me...I mean protect the upright citizens of Townston from those...sweaty, heaving, leering monsters with their bad boy ways. I want you to stop by and see what service you can assist me with later.

Objectives:

  • Poison Orok Moshers
  • Poison Mystic Moshers

Client level range: 35–50
